Saved Views is available today for everyone on a paid plan. Instead of rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a list, you can now capture that exact configuration and return to it in one click.

Each user can create up to 50 Saved Views, so whether you're tracking overdue tasks, this sprint's backlog, or work assigned to a specific teammate, your setup stays right where you left it. Views can also be shared with your team, so a workflow you build once can become the standard way everyone looks at a project—no more re-explaining which filters to apply or walking a new hire through the same setup twice.

This feature is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, and there's nothing to configure before you start using it.

We built Saved Views after hearing that teams wanted a faster way to get back to the exact slice of work that matters to them, and we think it'll quickly become part of your daily routine.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
